text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a national-scale, spatially explicit assessment of future land-use and land-cover change in Brazil through 2050 using the GLOBIOM-Brazil model. Its primary objective is to simulate and compare multiple future scenarios (including NoFC, FC, IDCAmazon, IDCBrazil, IDCImperfect variants, and FCnoCRA) to evaluate the environmental and agricultural impacts of Brazil’s Forest Code. The model operates on a 50 km × 50 km grid across the entire country, explicitly simulating deforestation, pasture expansion, cropland change, and forest restoration as part of LULC dynamics. Quantitative results include mapped projections (e.g., Figures 1, 3–5), area change metrics (e.g., 53.4 Mha of avoided deforestation), and validation against historical data (e.g., PRODES). All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale spatial implementation, primary focus on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy metrics, and mapped LULC outputs. It does not meet any exclusion criteria.)
